label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf’s Future Uncertain
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau said LIV’s Saudi PIF funding will end after 2026, and the league seeks $250–$350 million from new investors, pitching a 10-event team-golf schedule to survive.

items.headline: Clark Withdraws from Charles Schwab
items.text: Wyndham Clark withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge joining Brooks Koepka in removing two recent major champions from the Colonial field before the tournament starts.

items.headline: DeChambeau Optimistic on LIV
items.text: Despite surprise at the PIF pullout, Bryson DeChambeau remains optimistic about a viable business plan for LIV and focuses on improving his major form after missing cuts at the Masters and PGA.
